intro.title: From App Idea to the App Store
paragraphs: Your customers and employees spend most of their screen time in apps. A well-built mobile app puts your business on their home screen, makes ordering, booking or paying effortless and keeps people coming back with timely notifications. A poorly built one gets uninstalled within days.

As a mobile app development company, we handle every step: product strategy, UI/UX design, Android and iOS development, backend and APIs, testing on real devices, app store publishing and ongoing maintenance. We build native apps in Kotlin and Swift when performance matters most, and cross-platform apps in Flutter or React Native when you want one codebase for both platforms.

We work with startups launching an MVP and businesses adding apps to their existing systems, including ecommerce, healthcare, fintech, education and logistics apps. faqs.title: Mobile App Development FAQs
faqs.subtitle: Quick answers for anyone planning a mobile app.

items.q: How much does it cost to develop a mobile app?
items.a: A simple app or MVP typically costs $8,000 to $25,000, a business app for Android and iOS $25,000 to $60,000, and complex apps $60,000 or more, depending on features, design and backend.

items.q: How long does it take to build an app?
items.a: A simple app or MVP usually takes 2 to 3 months, a business app 3 to 5 months and complex apps 5 months or more, with test builds shared every week.

items.q: Should I choose native or cross-platform app development?
items.a: Native apps in Kotlin or Swift give the best performance and access to every device feature. Cross-platform apps in Flutter or React Native share one codebase for Android and iOS, reducing cost and time. We recommend based on your features, budget and roadmap.

items.q: Can you build an app for both Android and iOS?
items.a: Yes. We build for both platforms, either as two native apps or one cross-platform app, and publish them on the Google Play Store and Apple App Store.

items.q: Can you turn my website into a mobile app?
items.a: Yes. We can create a progressive web app from your website, or build a proper native or cross-platform app that connects to your existing website, store or backend.

items.q: Do I own the app and source code?
items.a: Yes. You own 100% of the source code, designs and app store listings. We sign an NDA before you share your idea, and offer maintenance and support after launch.
